items.quote: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
items.claim: Pharaoh requested Moses and Aaron to entreat the LORD to remove frogs in exchange for allowing the Israelite people to conduct sacrifice
items.action: called for; promised to let go
